query_original: How are penalties for causing a collision or on-track incident decided under the Sporting Regulations?
query_reformulada: What is the procedure for determining and applying penalties to drivers involved in collisions or on-track incidents as per Article 37.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations?
resposta: According to Article 37.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, penalties for causing a collision or on-track incident are decided by the stewards at their discretion. Unless it is clear that a driver was wholly or predominantly to blame for an Incident, no penalty will be imposed. The stewards may impose specific penalties as set out in these regulations, in addition to or instead of other available penalties.
